correctness.rationale: An explicit injection/disjointness argument bounds the sum of cardinalities of one-deletion intermediate shadows by n; singleton shadows imply two deleted positions in a single run; canonical same-run insertions have distinct integer checksum increments in [0,2n-1], so at most two can satisfy one residue; then 2L<=n+2. The all-zero descendant yields exactly floor(n/2)+1 zero-syndrome parents. All n>=2 are covered, with n=2 separated. Every received word at n=2..11 plus 144 longer samples checked independently by set-based enumeration; finite checks are not treated as an infinite proof.
